scripts.sim: esbuild tools/mock-daemon.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/mock-daemon.mjs --log-level=error && trap 'kill 0' EXIT; node node_modules/.cache/mock-daemon.mjs --port 19444 --token dev --device Sim-A --seed 1 & node node_modules/.cache/mock-daemon.mjs --port 19454 --token dev --device Sim-B --seed 2 --lag 1250 & wait
scripts.test: npm run test:sync && npm run test:flow && npm run test:affection
scripts.deploy: npm run build && rm -rf .deploy && cp -R dist .deploy && cd .deploy && git init -q -b gh-pages && git add -A && git commit -q -m 'Deploy Affectionalyzer' && git push -q -f https://github.com/anoopsinha/affectionalyzer.git gh-pages:gh-pages && cd .. && rm -rf .deploy
